nl: Write the relative paths of all .py files in inventory/ (recursively) to modules.txt, one path per line, sorted, with '/' as separator and without a leading './'.
oracle_program: find "inventory" glob: "**/*.py" type: file sort: name |> select relative |> write "modules.txt" format: lines
reference_bash: find inventory -type f -name '*.py' | sed 's|^\./||' | LC_ALL=C sort > modules.txt
